custom-property.description: CSS custom property (variable) declaration, resolved through the cascade

selector.description: Selector that a rule set applies to

<length>.description: A distance. Absolute (px, pt, cm, in) or relative (em, rem, ex, ch, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, %-adjacent). Zero may omit the unit.

<percentage>.description: A fraction of some reference value; what it resolves against depends on the property.

<number>.description: A plain integer or decimal, with no unit.

<integer>.description: A whole number, e.g. z-index or grid line indices.

<color>.description: A colour: named, #hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), lab(), lch(), oklch(), color-mix(), currentColor or transparent.

<angle>.description: A rotation in deg, grad, rad or turn.

<time>.description: A duration in s or ms — transition and animation timings.

<resolution>.description: A pixel density in dpi, dpcm or dppx, used in resolution media queries.

<image>.description: url(), a gradient, image-set() or element().

<position>.description: One or two keywords or lengths locating a point, as in background-position.

<ratio>.description: Two numbers separated by /, as in aspect-ratio: 16 / 9.

<custom-ident>.description: An author-defined name, e.g. a grid area or @keyframes name. Case-sensitive.

<dashed-ident>.description: An identifier beginning with two hyphens — the form custom properties take.

<length-percentage>.description: Either a <length> or a <percentage>; the pair calc() most often mixes.

<transform-function>.description: translate(), scale(), rotate(), skew(), matrix() and their 3D forms.

<easing-function>.description: linear, ease, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier(), steps() or linear().

<gradient>.description: linear-gradient(), radial-gradient(), conic-gradient() and their repeating- variants.

<display-outside>.description: block or inline — how the box participates in its parent's flow.

<display-inside>.description: flow, flow-root, table, flex, grid or ruby — how the box lays out its children.

<basic-shape>.description: inset(), circle(), ellipse(), polygon() or path(), for clip-path and shape-outside.

typeDefinitionPatterns.description: Navigate from var(--name) usage to the custom property definition (--name: value). Resolves through the cascade to find the most specific definition.
Navigate from animation-name usage to the @keyframes definition. Locates the keyframe animation sequence that defines the animation.
Navigate from font-family usage to the @font-face definition. Resolves custom font declarations including source files.
Navigate from grid-area name to the grid-template-areas definition in the parent grid container.
Navigate from list-style-type to @counter-style definition. Resolves custom counter style declarations.
Navigate from counter() or counters() function to the counter-reset that initializes the named counter.
Navigate from @import layer assignment to the @layer declaration that establishes the cascade layer.
Navigate from container-name definition to @container queries referencing this named container.
